fields.topic: First sampled loss versus physical collapse
fields.finding: Three independent perfect-branch continuations corroborate the fine-mesh trend. Finite sampling, ideal elastic material, and ideal rigid joints do not establish imperfection tolerance or physical collapse; resized f5 points were not independently continued nonlinearly.
